confirm.text: "Unsafe conditions" selected — one form only: William Jimmy Cooper, XTO, Wilde B 2, 01:19 PM, job 36127. The form carries no narrative describing an unsafe condition; the only continuation text is "Rees working safely". This fits the mis-selection pattern and needs his confirmation of what, if anything, he observed.

One form is the inverse pattern and is worth a closer look. Dawson Drake, XTO, Robbie 17A-8-F 2811H, 01:03 PM, job 36266, did not select "Unsafe conditions", but his narrative names a real one that was found and corrected on site:
"Upgrading of piping on the flow line on a gas lift well noticed a leak on one of the nuts on the valve where you grease. It tighten it up. Leak stopped"

Read as written, a leak was identified and resolved without incident. It is recorded here because a genuine field observation that is not reflected in the multi-select is the mirror image of the training point above, and because this is the kind of entry that should be easy to find later.

Repeat appearances: Nathan Contreras was on the stop-work confirmation list on 09/26; today he selected neither string. Bobby Galindo selected "discussed" today. Michael Jobe, who selected "Unsafe conditions" twice on 09/26, filed one air job today (36274) that carries no OWL section at all.

clean.text: Nothing required attention on the following. Raymundo Solis — one Trailer Inspection Form for trailer 148, full photo set, all captures on the day, FR Yes. Nathan Contreras — two Trailer Inspection Forms for 601 (06:11 AM and 02:37 PM, both at the Andrews shop), FR Yes on both, plus air job 36231 with a complete Learn section and a full narrative. Dawson Drake — two Trailer Inspection Forms for 603 (06:08 AM Andrews, 01:19 PM Midkiff), FR Yes on both, plus air job 36266, the most completely filled OWL review of the day and the only one carrying a specific field observation. Jacob Hernandez — two Trailer Inspection Forms for 608 (10:12 AM Andrews, 03:08 PM Midland), FR Yes on both, plus air job 36289_2 with nine observe items selected and a complete Learn section. Luis Zarate — two Trailer Inspection Forms for 602 (06:05 AM Andrews, 03:21 PM Vealmoor), FR Yes on both, plus air jobs 36086

Trailer forms of both kinds, and the equipment sections of the H2S daily, are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside the images, not as text, so this review can confirm that a photo was taken and when, but not what it shows. One further limitation specific to tonight: this review ran at 11:00 PM Central, so the usual check of the following morning's mail for late-arriving submissions could not be performed — any form for 10/26 that lands overnight is not reflected here.

75 of 75 submissions read. Both job boards were available: Blake Walton's 10/26/2026 email carrying the October ArkLaTex and Permian Basin workbooks, and the 10-26 sheet was used from each. 54 manned board rows were checked for coverage — 20 on the ArkLaTex board and 34 on the Permian Basin board — of which 43 were active assignments after removing rows marked ON STANDBY, ON HOLD, WTX SUPPORT, SHOP, CONTINGENCY and DAYS OFF.
